high_level_description: The image is a meme that humorously comments on the situation of American Express suspending operations in Russia and Belarus. The top part of the image features bold white text on a light background that reads: "AMERICAN EXPRESS HAS SUSPENDED OPERATIONS IN RUSSIA AND BELARUS." Below this text, there is an image of a hand holding an American Express Platinum card. The card is partially inserted into a black wallet, which also contains other cards and cash.
